title: HB2679 (2020 Regular Session): Changes the law regarding the concealed carrying of firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 571.030 (RSMo): 4. Subdivisions (1), (8), and (10) of subsection 1 of this section shall not apply to any person who has a valid concealed carry permit issued pursuant to sections 571.101 to 571.121, a valid concealed carry endorsement issued before August 28, 2013, a valid permit or endorsement to carry concealed firearms issued by another state or political subdivision of another state, or any person who carries a concealed weapon in a circumstance described under subsection 3 of this section.
Section 571.107 (RSMo): 2. Carrying of a concealed firearm in a location specified in subdivisions (1) to (17) of subsection 1 of this section by any individual shall not be a criminal act but may subject the person to denial to the premises or removal from the premises.
